rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip code to a single account, then used read-only tools to fetch the user’s orders and identify the correct delivered laptop. The agent located a replacement variant that exactly matched the requested specs (15-inch, i7, 8GB RAM, 1TB SSD), accurately presented pricing and the expected refund difference supported by tool data, and explicitly requested user confirmation before performing the exchange. The write action was executed only after confirmation, targeted the correct order item and new item IDs, and the tool response confirmed the exchange and refund amount. Final information given to the user matched the tool outputs. No policy violations or fabrications observed.
